hook_text: Everyone on this train is missing it

song.title: Above Ground
song.style: English, breezy bossa nova with nylon guitar, soft brushed drums and flute, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 96 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Morning train, the usual crowd
Every head bowed, nobody loud
Slid my phone in its orange sleeve
Looked outside, could not believe

[Chorus]
Mountains rolling past the glass
Cows and rivers, fields of grass
Look up, look out, look around
Best show in town is above ground

[Verse]
Girl across was drawing birds
Showed me one without a word
Shared my orange, she shared her pen
Drew the window, drew it again

[Chorus]
Missed my stop and I don't mind
Left the scrolling world behind
Look up, look out, look around
Best show in town is above ground

shots.prompt: {moss} sits in a train carriage full of passengers who all stare down at their laps, the only one looking up and around, curious. Static wide shot. Soft morning light.
{moss} glances around the quiet carriage at all the bowed heads and shrugs. Static medium shot. Soft window light.

A hand gently slides a black smartphone all the way down into a slim terracotta-orange sleeve standing upright on a soft cream studio backdrop, until the phone disappears inside and only the rounded thumb notch at the top remains. A small closed-eye emblem is pressed into the front of the sleeve. The hand pulls away and the sleeve stands still, casting a soft shadow. Static close-up, the light slowly turns warmer.
{moss} presses his face to the train window, his eyes going wide behind his glasses. Static close-up. Bright daylight.
Rolling green mountains, a sparkling river and grazing cows slide past outside a train window. The camera holds steady inside the train. Bright clear daylight.
a girl with curly black hair and a yellow scarf across the aisle quietly shows {moss} a drawing of a bird in her sketchbook, and he beams. Static medium shot. Warm window light.
{moss} peels an orange and shares it with a girl with curly black hair and a yellow scarf, both laughing. Static medium shot. Golden light.
{moss} and a girl with curly black hair and a yellow scarf draw the view together in her sketchbook as fields rush past. Static close-up. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} steps off the train onto a tiny countryside station platform at sunset, smiling, as the train pulls away. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss slid his phone into its Eyelid on the morning train, made a friend, and missed his stop. Worth it.
